a.lede: The Jensen Huang era of Nvidia nearly came to an end this month. Huang, who three decades ago cofounded what's come to be considered one of the most important companies in AI, resigned from his role on November 12th over mounting scrutiny around his alleged affairs. b.lede: An Nvidia robotics engineer that quit in response to Jensen Huang's resignation says he "may have moved too quickly" now that CEO is back in charge.
